notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
Version 1.03
-made the banana more stable by strengthening the ragdoll controller.
-got the problem with camera tracking solved mostly
-the banana now can walk up angles up to 80 degrees.  This improves ability to move around the level.
-got rid of “Created By” field, I use the steam persona name from now on
